head: codex/92-runtime-tls-standardization
title: runtime: standardize TLS and mTLS on Axum and Rustls
body:
## Summary

- use one shared Rustls identity and trust policy across Runtime transports
- use Axum for HTTP, HTTPS, and WSS while retaining Quinn only for Guardian QUIC
- remove Runtime-owned self-signed issuance, host trust-store mutation, and duplicate TLS proof machinery
- consume externally provisioned certificate, key, and CA files with standard WebPKI verification

## Validation

- focused Axum control, Runtime WSS, Quinn mTLS, protocol mTLS, certificate-policy, lifecycle-fixture, and OpenAPI contract lanes pass
- independent exact-head review: PASS
- diff hygiene: PASS

Closes #92
